in_hebrew.name: בינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The meaning of the Hebrew name Bena is 'son of the south'. This name is derived from the Hebrew word 'ben', which means 'son', and 'ayin', which means 'south'. Bena could be considered a place name, referring to someone from the south.

biblical_reference.note: Bena is mentioned in the Hebrew Bible as the names of three different individuals. In Genesis, it is the name of Jacob's servant who went to meet Esau. In Judges, it is the name of a judge of the tribe of Benjamin. In 1 Chronicles, it is the name of a descendant of Judah.
